sample-policy.rego:
package sample.provenance
import rego.v1

default allow := false

# The trusted runner supplies only the exact statement cosign verified,
# and computes the expected digest from the supplied artifact bytes.
allow if {
  input.statement._type == "https://in-toto.io/Statement/v1"
  input.statement.predicateType == "https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1"
  is_array(input.statement.subject)
  count(input.statement.subject) == 1
  input.statement.subject[0].name == "artifact.txt"
  input.statement.subject[0].digest.sha256 == input.expected.artifact_sha256
  input.statement.predicate.runDetails.builder.id == "https://example.test/builders/sample-v1"
}
